people.name: Judas

people.name: Silas
people.line: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

translations.web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.
translations.bsb: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the brothers.
